home.heading: What shall we make?
home.intro: Pick a picture. Read with your helper. Stop to try things along the way.

notebook.empty: Draw or write your first idea.

errors.missing_lesson: That project could not open. Pick another picture.

helper.heading: For grown-ups
helper.setup: Use the matching lesson in Young_Inventors_Helper_Guide.pdf for exact parts, wiring, code and checks. Illustrations show ideas, not wiring.
helper.status: All physical trials, Arduino-core compilation and child pilots remain pending. Review the actual kit before a shared activity.
helper.age: The words are intended for shared reading with younger children, roughly 6–9. Hardware tasks still need adult preparation and individual readiness checks.
helper.time: Full activities typically take 25–60 minutes; a read-aloud can stop earlier.
helper.storage: If notes are saved in this browser, other people using the same browser may see them. Clearing browser data can remove them.
helper.privacy: No name, photo, account or public post is needed. Public uploads are outside this curriculum handoff.
helper.independent_build: The child pages do not contain complete build instructions. Use the separate technical helper guide throughout.
